Hi Alice / team,

I pulled the audit and the 500 correlates with the SAML handoff for the /accept endpoint. Two likely culprits: RelayState truncation on long query strings or SameSite cookie rejection for our accept-session on older browser builds. The audit log shows a 400 -> 500 transition at the auth callback (nameid present but relaystate missing).

Immediate steps:
1) Can you try the new invite link in an incognito window (no extensions) and report if it still fails?
2) If available, try from a different device (desktop vs phone). Weve observed iOS Safari occasionally reject the auth cookie.

Ive reissued a short-lived rekeyed invite here: https://ariba.redwood.ai/invite/rekey/ABc123-retry (expires in 1 hour). Please try that and paste any error message if it fails.

Ive also created a support ticket with the trace attached: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/RED-123456.

Attaching quick debug steps: debug-instructions.txt
